content: {"summary":"Customers complain the new dashboard feels forced, cluttered, and non‑intuitive, citing oversized icons and a confusing layout.[#tk_873361,#tk_2080250,#tk_315837] They report difficulty navigating tabs, a lack of backward compatibility, and frustration over the inability to revert to the previous design.[#tk_1852536,#tk_2337184,#tk_2069091] Users also highlight missing notifications and a perceived loss of usability, demanding a return to the old interface now in daily use.[#tk_2319195,#tk_1282996,#tk_2335977,#tk_888655]"}
